dimensions.detail: spans 2024-01-01 to 2024-01-31 (30 days); sorted; 0 unparseable timestamps
no identifier-like text columns among features

quality.note: Scores describe the data as published. Nothing here is repaired at the ingestion layer; remediation happens inside the modelling pipeline where it can be fitted per-fold.

rules.reason: A trip cannot end before it starts; these are meter or clock faults.
The TLC caps a metered yellow-cab trip well below 3 hours; longer records are almost always a meter left running.
Zero-distance trips are cancelled hails or meter errors, not journeys.
60 miles exceeds any within-city trip; these are out-of-area or GPS faults.
Negative and zero fares are voided transactions and chargebacks.
Above $500 the record is a data-entry error rather than a taxi ride.
A yellow cab seats at most six; 0 means the driver never entered a count.
Sub-walking-pace or highway-speed averages indicate a corrupt timestamp pair.

exclusions.policy: Rows are removed only by physical-plausibility rules stated in advance. No rule references the target's distribution, so no hard case is deleted for being hard.
